items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Well that's the time that Junior Cobb's come heard me play

ctx.x: Was this the same band that made the recordings?

No, no. Every time they make recordings, it's a couple of different bands, you know. One place I worked, I never did get to tell you, where I was doing very good, a place they called it the Bookstore, on 35th Street. It would open say twelve o'clock at night, and catch all the performance from all nightclubs and things, see. They called it the Bookstore, but they sold, you know, whisking stuff and things like that. But they did sell books in the front, and we had a little four piece outfit in there, and we just…
What was the name of the club that Huey Swift was in?
